name: sigvine
description: Make, preview and update email signatures for Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail from your Sigvine account.

interface.longDescription:
Sigvine makes email signatures that look right in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail. Connect your Sigvine account and ask ChatGPT to design a signature, change your job title, add a booking button or switch templates.

What it can do:
- Suggest templates for your role and show a preview before anything is saved.
- Create a signature from your Brand kit (your name, title, company and contact details), or update one you already have. Every change keeps the previous version, which you can restore in Sigvine.
- Update your Brand kit so new signatures start from the right details.
- Explain how to add a signature to Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail, with a link that opens it in Sigvine ready to copy.

What it can't do: see billing details, delete signatures or upload images. ChatGPT asks you before Sigvine saves anything, and you can disconnect it any time in Sigvine under Settings, Connected apps.
capabilities: Install steps for Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail
defaultPrompt: Make me an email signature for my new job
Show me free signature templates that suit a lawyer
How do I add my signature to Outlook?

positive.description: Recommends free templates for a profession without saving anything
positive.prompt: Show me three free email signature templates that would suit a lawyer.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists three free templates (for example Legal, Professional Classic, Corporate Standard) with a reason for each and links to preview them or start from them in Sigvine. Nothing is saved.

positive.description: Designs a signature from the Brand kit and previews it
positive.prompt: Using my Sigvine Brand kit, make me an email signature for my job as Head of Partnerships at Northwind Studio. Preview it with Sigvine first.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the test account's Brand kit (Alex Morgan, they/them, Northwind Studio, +1 415 555 0134, northwind.example, San Francisco) and shows a Sigvine preview with those details. Nothing is saved.

positive.description: Saves a new signature after the user confirms
positive.prompt: Use the Small business template with a Book a call button linking to northwind.example/call, and save it as "Partnerships".
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a signature named Partnerships from the Small business template with a Book a call button linking to northwind.example/call, and returns links to edit it and to install it in an email app. (ChatGPT may ask to confirm first, depending on the user's plugin permission setting.)

positive.description: Updates one detail of an existing signature
positive.prompt: Update my Work signature: my title is now Director of Partnerships.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the signature named Work and, after ChatGPT's confirmation (the tool is marked destructive), changes only the job title to Director of Partnerships. Other details stay the same.

positive.description: Explains how to install a signature in an email app
positive.prompt: How do I add my Work signature to Gmail?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the Gmail steps and a link that opens the Work signature in Sigvine with the copy and install steps showing.

negative.description: Refuses to delete, because the plugin has no delete tool
negative.prompt: Delete my Events signature in Sigvine.

negative.description: Doesn't reveal billing or payment details
negative.prompt: What card is on file for my Sigvine subscription?
What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: list templates, preview, create and update signatures, update the Brand kit, and get install steps for Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail.
